headline: Conspiracy Theory Claims All Zuber Drivers Are Same Person in Different Wigs
subheadline: Users compile 'evidence' of matching facial features across 200+ rides
summary: A viral Threadit thread has users convinced their rideshare drivers are all the same individual in various disguises.
content:
A Threadit thread titled "I think my Zuber driver is the same guy every time" has accumulated 15,000 upvotes and spawned an entire community dedicated to proving that all Zuber drivers are, in fact, the same person.

"It started as a feeling," wrote original poster u/RideShareTruth. "Every driver had the same energy. The same pause before asking about my day. The same slightly-too-long look in the rearview mirror. Then I started paying attention."

The subreddit r/OneDriver has since compiled what members call "irrefutable evidence": side-by-side comparisons of driver photos from different rides, analyses of driving patterns, and a spreadsheet tracking 847 rides across 12 cities that all allegedly share "the same left-hand grip on the steering wheel."

"Look at the earlobe," one user commented on a comparison post. "LOOK AT THE EARLOBE."

Zuber has released a statement calling the theory "flattering to our rigorous driver recruitment standards" but denying that they employ only one person. The statement continued: "We have many drivers. So many drivers. Different drivers. This is normal."

Users found the denial suspicious.

"Why did they say 'this is normal'?" asked one commenter. "No one asked if it was normal. That's exactly what you'd say if it wasn't normal."

The theory has several proposed explanations: an elaborate prank, a glitch in the simulation, or what one user called "a really dedicated guy with a lot of wigs and a concerning work ethic."

The original poster has since updated the thread: "He just picked me up again. Different name, different car, same guy. He winked at me."

At press time, Zuber's stock was unaffected, though searches for "Zuber same driver" had increased by 847%.
author: Marcus Webb, Internet Culture Correspondent
